title: 第21章 有妖怪第22章 冷千杀
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
这袁天虎名义上是他的徒弟，实则是他年轻时在外风流留下的私生子。
赤焰谷怎么说也是南域四大宗门，为了宗门颜面，所以袁烈只能将袁天虎收为弟子培养。
这件事当年闹得沸沸扬扬，同辈人都心知肚明。
袁天虎所得到的修炼资源跟教导是不可能跟其他徒弟一样的。
看着袁烈那一脸小人得志的表情，林青河无奈道：“我凌霄剑宗输得起！”
袁烈哈哈一笑：“好，够爽快！”
这时穆无双道：“我们还没有输，你家老二还没来。
已经有弟子去找他了！”
林青河眼睛一亮，对呀，我把这个酒痴给忘了，这个是个无敌的家伙。
楼万里也点头道：“确实，他要是来了，肯定没有悬念。”
袁烈不耐道：“你们宗门年轻一代有人比宁飞还强？你不会是想拖延时间吧？”
林青河道：“你不会连这点时间都等不了吧？”
袁烈冷哼一声，袁天虎一脸傲然的站在台上。
片刻后，阎川背着秦风出现在众人面前，秦峰此刻还在呼呼大睡，他还有点纳闷，怎么有点颠簸呢。
难道地震了？
阎川道：“宗主，秦峰师兄到了！”
袁烈看到秦峰后，哈哈笑道：“一个酒鬼？还是筑基期？”
“林宗主，你不是在跟我开玩笑吧？”
林青河此刻也面露尴尬，不知道该说什么好。
穆无双捂住自己的额头，一脸无语道：“老二，醒醒！”

秦峰缓缓睁开眼睛，看到穆无双阴沉的脸，然后道：“师父，你怎么来我这里了？”
穆无双板着脸道：“你酒量不行就少喝点，你看看这里是哪？”
秦峰揉了揉眼睛，看到周围有上千双眼睛都盯着他，此刻还在重影，他迅速一个飞跃跳到了穆无双身后道：“是幻觉，师父，有妖怪！”
这一幕顿时引起众人哈哈大笑，穆无双一脸尴尬。
她敲了一下秦峰的头道：“妖你个头啊！”
“你现在下去把台上那个家伙给我打死，否则我就把你打成妖怪。”
秦峰又揉了又揉眼睛，此刻清醒了不少，才发现是宗门师兄弟。
众人都用一种怪异的眼神看着他。
想想自己好像因为晋升，喝断片了，人就是在高兴的时候跟难过的时候是最容易喝醉的。
他晃晃悠悠的向台上走去。
这时袁烈愕然道：“林宗主，你是认真的？”
他本来以为林青河只是不甘心，开个玩笑而已，没想到还真的让秦峰上台。
穆无双道：“我徒儿最近在修炼一门需要喝酒才能练的剑术，所以喝多了点。”
“但是威力十分强大，等下你们就会看到！”
其他人都一脸狐疑的看向穆无双，脸上写满了不相信。
穆无双脸上火辣辣的，这个臭小子，又害自己丢脸，但她也没有办法，只能编这个理由了。
秦峰走上台，袁天虎一脸不屑道：“你能站稳吗？”
秦峰没理会他，看着台下一众期待的眼神道：“各位，刚才来的匆忙，没带剑，谁借我一下。”
content_en:
This Yuan Tianhu is his apprentice in name, but in fact he is the illegitimate son he left behind when he was young and had a romantic affair.
After all, Scarlet Flame Valley was one of the four major sects in the Southern Region. For the sake of the sect's reputation, Yuan Lie could only accept Yuan Tianhu as a disciple to train.
This incident caused quite a stir at the time, and everyone of my generation was well aware of it.
It is impossible for Yuan Tianhu to receive the same training resources and teachings as other disciples.
Seeing Yuan Lie's triumphant expression, Lin Qinghe said helplessly: "I, the Lingxiao Sword Sect, can afford to lose!"
Yuan Lie laughed: "Okay, that's refreshing!"
At this time Mu Wushuang said: "We haven't lost yet, your second son hasn't come yet.
Disciples are already looking for him! "
Lin Qinghe's eyes lit up, yes, I forgot about this alcoholic, this guy is invincible.
Lou Wanli also nodded and said: "Indeed, if he comes, there will definitely be no suspense."
Yuan Lie said impatiently: "Is there anyone in the younger generation of your sect who is better than Ning Fei? Are you trying to delay time?"
Lin Qinghe said: "You can't even wait for this little time, can you?"
Yuan Lie snorted coldly, and Yuan Tianhu stood on the stage with a proud look.
A moment later, Yan Chuan appeared in front of everyone with Qin Feng on his back. Qin Feng was still sleeping soundly at this moment. He was still a little puzzled as to why he was a little bumpy.
Was there an earthquake?
Yan Chuan said: "Sect Master, Senior Brother Qin Feng is here!"
After Yuan Lie saw Qin Feng, he laughed and said: "A drunkard? Or is he in the foundation building stage?"
"Sect Leader Lin, are you kidding me?"
Lin Qinghe also looked embarrassed at this moment, not knowing what to say.
Mu Wushuang covered his forehead and said speechlessly: "Second brother, wake up!"
Qin Feng slowly opened his eyes and saw Mu Wushuang's gloomy face, and then said: "Master, why are you here?"
Mu Wushuang said with a straight face: "If you can't drink enough, drink less. Look where we are here."
Qin Feng rubbed his eyes and saw thousands of pairs of eyes staring at him. They were still ghosting at this moment. He quickly jumped behind Mu Wushuang and said: "It's an illusion, Master, there are monsters!"
This scene immediately caused everyone to laugh, and Mu Wushuang looked embarrassed.
She knocked Qin Feng on the head and said, "What a monster!"
"Go down now and beat that guy on the stage to death, or I'll beat you into a monster."
Qin Feng rubbed his eyes again and again, and now he was quite awake, only to realize that it was his sect brother.
Everyone looked at him with strange eyes.
Thinking about it, I seem to have stopped drinking because of my promotion. People are most likely to get drunk when they are happy or sad.
He walked unsteadily towards the stage.
At this time, Yuan Lie said in shock: "Sect Master Lin, are you serious?"
He originally thought that Lin Qinghe was just not willing to give in and was just joking, but he didn't expect that he would actually let Qin Feng come on stage.
Mu Wushuang said: "My disciple has recently been practicing a swordsmanship that requires drinking, so he drank a little too much."
"But it is very powerful, you will see it later!"
Everyone else looked at Mu Wushuang suspiciously, with disbelief written all over their faces.
Mu Wushuang's face was burning. This brat was embarrassing herself again, but she had no choice but to make up this excuse.
When Qin Feng walked onto the stage, Yuan Tianhu said with disdain, "Can you stand firm?"
Qin Feng ignored him, looked at the expectant eyes of everyone in the audience and said, "Everyone, I came in a hurry just now and didn't bring my sword. Can someone lend me one?"
